meta.name: Frankie Freako
meta.description: After calling a late-night party hotline that promises out-of-this-world fun, uptight yuppie Conor Sweeney must battle the pint-sized forces of evil unleashed through his phone line, led by the maniacal rock n’ roll goblin FRANKIE FREAKO.
meta.slogan: Fasten your freakbelts for a wild night.
